SELECT runtime.*
         FROM bees AS bee
         JOIN runtimes AS runtime
           ON runtime.bee_id = bee.id
          AND runtime.generation = (
            SELECT MAX(latest.generation) FROM runtimes AS latest WHERE latest.bee_id = bee.id
          )
         ORDER BY bee.id
